sentences.text: The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the respondents to pay appropriate compensation to the petitioners for acquisition of their land including the houses constructed over the same appertaining to plot nos. 752 and 2545, Khata No. 01, Mouza- Madangundi, Chandwara measuring an area of about 13 decimals 7 dhurs for widening/four-laning of NH-31 from 5.350 Km to 47.700 Km (Barhi-Rajauli Section) in district- Koderma.

Further prayer has been made for issuance of direction upon the concerned respondents to verify the fact as to whether the said land of the petitioners are concerned with any dispute of right, title and interest as has been wrongly stated in the order dated 09.04.2022 passed under Section 3H(4) of the National Highways Act, 1956 (in short, "the Act, 1956") in Land Acquisition Case No. 19/2014-15 and 146/2017-18 and the said cases have been referred to the Land Acquisition Court, Koderma under Section 3H(4) of the Act, 1956.

sentences.text:
2. After some argument, learned counsel for the petitioners, prays for withdrawal of the writ petition with liberty to the petitioners to pursue the Land Acquisition Case Nos. 19/2014-15 and 146/2017-18 pending in the Land Acquisition Court, Koderma pursuant to reference made under Section 3H(4)
of the Act, 1956.
3. The writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn with aforesaid liberty.

Ritesh/ (Rajesh Shankar, J.)
